name: Albacon
blurb: An annual science-fiction and fantasy fan convention in the Albany, NY area, run by the LASTSFA fan club.
notes: The live site (albacon.org, which redirects to /2025/) only has the 2025 edition (Sept 12-14, 2025, at the Courtyard Albany in Clifton Park, NY), which ended before the research window. albacon.org/2026/ resolves to a bare, mostly-default WordPress install (Twenty Twenty-Five theme) with an unrelated 'Relaxacon in Saratoga Springs' placeholder text and the theme's own stock 404 image — not a real announcement, so no 2026 dates are recorded. No next edition has been publicly announced as of 2026-10-05; Albacon itself remains active (ran in 2025, organized continuously by LASTSFA since 1996 per Wikipedia).
